messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm supposed to go to your 
pad {07 0b 00}at {04 10 00}:{04 11 00}, am I right?
You DO mean on the {04 0f 00}?
{07 0d 00}Make sure to be somewhere
where you can hear someone
hollerin' from outside!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma pidin sinu juurde tulema 
{07 0b 00}kell {04 10 00}:{04 11 00}, eks?
Sa MÕTLED {04 0f 00}?
{07 0d 00}Ole kindlasti kusagil, kus
sa kuuled, kui keegi õuest
hõikab!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, better be sure you're
around at {04 10 00}:{04 11 00}! And
I DO mean on the {04 0f 00}!
{07 14 00}No need to do any cleanage!{01 01 00}
{07 0d 00}I wanna see it in a
natural state, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, ole kindlasti kohal
kell {04 10 00}:{04 11 00}!
Ja ma MÕTLEN {04 0f 00}!
{07 14 00}Pole vaja koristada!{01 01 00}
{07 0d 00}Ma tahan seda näha
loomulikus olekus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I just checked my calendar!
House party at your pad at
{04 10 00}:{04 11 00} on the {04 0f 00}!
{07 0d 00}Make sure you don't miss
the sound of my fist
bangin' on your door!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma vaatasin just kalendrit!
Majapidu sinu juures kell
{04 10 00}:{04 11 00} {04 0f 00}!
{07 0d 00}Vaata, et sa ei jäta
kuulmata mu rusika
põrinat su uksel!
